en.headline: Study links Northern Metropolis land clearance to higher stray animal intakes
en.dek: Researchers found about 40 per cent of animals taken in by six rescue groups in the first half of the year came from the development area, with groups calling for policy review.
body: The Animal Welfare Advocacy Alliance released findings on Monday showing that over 40 per cent of stray animals taken in by six non-governmental rescue organisations between January and June came from the Northern Metropolis development area.

The pro bono study by Dr Kelvin Lam Ka-wang of Baptist University and Associate Professor Paul Wong Wai-ching of the University of Hong Kong analysed intake records from the groups. Volunteers warned that more than 1,000 animals face abandonment as land resumption accelerates.

The alliance called for a review of euthanasia policies, the relaunch of a trap-neuter-resettlement programme, and the introduction of a positive duty of care for companion animals. One researcher noted that while about half the New Territories cases were in the Northern Metropolis area, the figures cannot be directly attributed solely to the development.

zh.headline: 研究指北部都會區收地與流浪動物接收量上升有關
zh.dek: 研究發現今年上半年六個救援組織接收的動物中約四成來自發展區，團體呼籲檢討政策。
body: 動物福利關注聯盟周一公布研究結果，指今年1月至6月期間，六個非政府救援組織接收的流浪動物中，逾四成來自北部都會區發展範圍。
浸會大學林家宏博士與香港大學黃偉慶副教授進行的義務研究分析了各組織的接收紀錄。義工警告，隨着收地加速，逾千隻動物面臨被遺棄風險。
聯盟呼籲檢討人道毀滅政策、重推「捕捉-絕育-安置」計劃，並引入對伴侶動物的積極照顧責任。有研究員指出，雖然新界個案中約半數位於北部都會區，但數字不能直接完全歸因於發展項目。
